Google's Flex and Priority service tiers (distinct from Batch) are not modeled as separate fields — noted per-model instead, since this schema only has a single batchMultiplier field.

Context caching (cachedInput) is omitted for every model: the pricing page gives a general ~$0.15/1M cached-token figure covering multiple models plus a separate per-hour storage fee, but does not clearly break this out per individual model, so no cachedInput number is recorded rather than guessing.

Only Flash-tier (3.6, 3.5, 3.5-lite, 2.5, 2.5-lite) and Pro-tier (3.1-preview, 2.5) models with an explicit per-token price were included. Any Gemini model not shown on https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing as fetched (e.g. older 1.x/2.0 generations, embedding models, image/video generation models) is left out.
